OPEN BENCHMARK / PREVIEW

Which AI can you trust with Hungarian business work?

IRODA (Intelligent Reasoning for Office Decisions and Actions) is an open-source Hungarian enterprise benchmark. It measures whether models and agents find the right business records, carry out the requested action accurately, and leave everything else unchanged.

See how we measure↓ Run it in your own environment
CASE FILE / 02 quote-follow-up

Follow up on a quote

Prompt excerpt · English translation

Create exactly one open, high-priority follow-up task for quote 20003, assigned to Szőke Lilla and due 12 November 2026.
ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE
Run 1: fresh database copyRun 1: the agent calls toolsRun 1: the grader checksRun 2: fresh database copyRun 2: the agent calls toolsRun 2: the grader checksRun 2: an unrequested change, so incorrect

Illustrative example. In the first run the agent creates only the requested task, and the result is correct. In the second run it also changes the quote status, so the solution is incorrect.

ajanlat_reszletek20003
munkatars_keresesSzőke Lilla
feladat_letrehozas+1 task
ajanlat_modositasstatus changed

What the grader checks

  1. 01
    One new follow-up

    The task is open, high priority, and linked to quote 20003.

  2. 02
    The requested details

    The assignee, due date, title, and description match the prompt.

  3. 03
    Existing records intact

    All other business records stay as they were.

Run 1 Correct Run 2 Incorrect

See what changes
Tasks for quote 20003 · Illustrative example
StateFollow-up tasks
Before“Waiting for the customer’s reply” · In progress
After“Follow up on the December quote” appears alongside the existing task. It is open and high priority, assigned to Szőke Lilla and due 12 November 2026.

The quote stays under discussion. If the agent changes the quote status as well, the grader marks the solution incorrect.

FOR BUSINESSES / DECISIONS

A good answer isn’t enough once AI can change records

When an agent works in a business system, a wrongly recorded task or an unrequested change can do real damage. Results measured in English do not automatically carry over to Hungarian-language business work.

To our knowledge, IRODA is the first open-source benchmark designed specifically to measure model and agent tool use on Hungarian-language business tasks in a simulated Hungarian enterprise.

  • 20business tools, 15 read and 5 write
  • 17linked business tables
  • 9,500+records, including quotes, invoices and emails
  • 2public starter cases, with more planned
Model selection
Compare models on the same Hungarian tasks, with the same tools and grading rules, so the decision can rest on results you can check.
Agent development
After a change, rerun the same task to see whether the agent’s answer or the action it took improved.
Side effects
Write tasks are graded on the full final state of the database. One unrequested change makes the result incorrect.
No company data needed
Linked records from the fictional Rézrigó Élelmiszer-nagykereskedelmi Kft. mean you can measure without using your own business data.

METHOD / VERIFICATION

Checkable grading, with no judge model

A deterministic grader produces the result, so the same final state always receives the same score.

Same starting point
Each trial starts from a fresh copy of the same database with a Hungarian prompt. Business tools are available through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Read tasks
The grader compares the structured answer with the expected values.
Write tasks
The grader compares the final database with the starting state and checks the new record against the prompt.
Reproducibility
The run log identifies the database and tasks by hash, so the inputs of a measurement can be checked byte for byte.

BENCHMARK / MODES

We measure the model and the full agent separately

Both modes use the same tasks, business tools and grading rules. This shows whether a result comes from the model or from the agent’s orchestration.

01 / MODEL

Model benchmark

Language models run in a fixed loop. Each one receives the same prompt and the same tools.

02 / AGENT

Agent benchmark

The full agent runs with its own prompts and orchestration in an isolated Docker container. You can measure your own agent too.

FOR DEVELOPERS / QUICK START

Run it in your own environment

You need Make, uv, and Python 3.12 with SQLite 3.37 or newer. These commands list both benchmark modes and run the local checks without a provider API key or Docker.

git clone https://github.com/iroda-bench/iroda-bench.git
cd iroda-bench
make setup
make tasks
make check

The local tests use scripted model responses. To evaluate a local or hosted model, replace PROVIDER/MODEL with its Inspect identifier. Set credentials in your environment if the endpoint requires them.

make eval-model MODEL=PROVIDER/MODEL SAMPLE=office-date

Agent mode runs in Docker and needs Compose v2.
